summary.title: CI/CD Pipeline Threat Model
summary.description: STRIDE threat model for the demo build-and-deploy pipeline.

threats.title: OAuth Token Replay Against Deploy Step
threats.description: A captured deploy token could be replayed against the artifact registry to push an unauthorized build.
threats.mitigation: Short-lived, single-use deploy tokens; network-level replay detection.

threats.title: Unpinned Third-Party Actions Allow Supply Chain Tampering
threats.description: Workflow steps reference third-party actions by tag, not commit SHA. A compromised upstream action runs with full pipeline privileges.
threats.mitigation: Pin all actions to a commit SHA; enable Dependabot for action updates.

threats.title: Pipeline Actions Are Not Attributable to an Individual
threats.description: Deploy actions triggered by the CI service account cannot be traced back to the engineer who merged the triggering PR.
threats.mitigation: Correlate deploy logs with PR merge author in the audit trail.

threats.title: Unvalidated Environment Variables Leak Secrets on Crash
threats.description: Secrets injected as environment variables are not validated before use; a crash handler could dump the environment into logs.
threats.mitigation: Validate and redact secret-bearing env vars before any logging path.

threats.title: Dependency Registry Outage Causes Uncontrolled Build Failure
threats.description: The pipeline has no retry or timeout handling around package registry calls; a slow or unavailable registry hangs the build indefinitely.
threats.mitigation: Add bounded retries with backoff and an explicit timeout around all registry calls.

threats.title: Historical Finding — Already Mitigated
threats.description: Previously the checkout step had no timeout. This is fixed and excluded from re-validation by default.
threats.mitigation: timeout-minutes added to the checkout step.
